note: Upstream Python package at the tag. The compiled extensions (csrc) come from the pinned container's install of the same tag; tools/stage-vllm-overlay.sh layers this tree over that install. vllm/vllm/config/fault_tolerance.py is stored LF-normalized (upstream has CRLF).

local_patches.why: GB10 exposes no NVML memory clock; fall back to 273 GB/s for humming's tuning heuristic
VLLM_HUMMING_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 turns on humming's deterministic MoE kernels without the global batch-invariant mode (which forces CUTLASS W4A4 on W4A16 linears)

local_patches.file: vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/ops/ssd_pinned_configs.py (+ pins in ssd_state_passing.py, ssd_bmm.py, ssd_chunk_scan.py, ssd_chunk_state.py)
local_patches.why: Triton autotune picked different SSD tile configs per boot on GB10, making the same prompt yield one of two token streams; each kernel is pinned to one config (VLLM_MAMBA_SSD_AUTOTUNE=1 restores autotuning)
skip the MTP drafter when every request in the batch has max_tokens == 1: its drafts are never verified, and the drafter's pass over the prompt delayed the sampled token (the timed prefill)
